title: let _ suppressor pattern is confusing alongside live if-block
description: session.rs:187-198: connection_whitelisted is assigned (line 191), genuinely used in an if-block (line 195), then suppressed with 'let _ = connection_whitelisted' (line 198). The suppressor comment says it exists for the greylisting epic (stoa-ef702cf6), but a maintainer editing either the if-block or the suppressor independently can leave the other dangling. The idiomatic pattern for a placeholder flag consumed by a future feature is to leave the variable live and add a TODO comment, not to suppress it after using it. Mitigation: when mgzn lands, remove the suppressor and the comment together as one atomic change, tracked in the mgzn epic.
